description: This file defines a LoggingHandler class that extends Netty's ChannelDuplexHandler to provide detailed logging of network channel events, including message data in hex and character formats.

classes.name: LoggingHandler
classes.description: A Netty channel handler that logs channel events and message contents in a detailed, formatted manner, including hex and ASCII representations.

methods.name: LoggingHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger with a specified name.

methods.name: addLoggingHandler
methods.description: Adds this logging handler to the channel pipeline, positioning it after SSL handler if present.

methods.name: channelRegistered
methods.description: Logs when the channel is registered.

methods.name: channelUnregistered
methods.description: Logs when the channel is unregistered.

methods.name: channelActive
methods.description: Logs when the channel becomes active.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Logs when the channel becomes inactive.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Logs exceptions caught during channel operation.

methods.name: userEventTriggered
methods.description: Logs user events, including SSL handshake completion and other exceptions.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Logs bind events with local address.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Logs connect events with remote and local addresses.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Logs disconnect events.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Logs close events.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Logs deregistration events.

methods.name: channelRead
methods.description: Logs received messages.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Logs messages being written.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Logs flush events.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Helper to log formatted message content.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats channel context info and message details for logging.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats message content based on its type (ByteBuf, ByteBufHolder, or other).

methods.name: formatByteBuf
methods.description: Creates a hex and ASCII dump of ByteBuf content.

methods.name: formatByteBufHolder
methods.description: Formats ByteBufHolder content.

methods.name: formatNonByteBuf
methods.description: Formats non-byte buffer messages as string with length.
